Package hadur117.core.move

Class FieldPriorData

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.move.FieldPriorData
final class FieldPriorData extends Object
MOVE-35: the field prior's table, fitted offline by data/tools/gun_oracle.py prior on the K1 oracle's bullets (docs/bench/gun-oracle.md, "K1 step 3"): 46719 enemy bullets from 48 learning guns on flat movers (hadur-bench/k0-cloud.txt, 2026-10-29), each counted once in the cell of the state it was aimed at and the guess-factor bin it went to. Generated: do not edit by hand.

Cells are indexed lateral speed, then acceleration, then wall room ahead, then flight time (the first index varying fastest), with the bin edges FieldPrior reads. Each row is one cell's 41 guess-factor bins over [-1, 1], as counts.
